audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Job's integrity language, sons of God, ha-satan as the Accuser, divine court scene, hedge/hand language, calamity reports, Job's mourning, and refusal to charge the Divine with wrong.

verses.restored: There was a man in the land of Uz whose name was Job. That man was whole, upright, fearing the Divine and turning away from evil.

familiar.text: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

verses.restored: Seven sons and three daughters were born to him.

familiar.text: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

verses.restored: His livestock were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and very many servants. That man was greater than all the sons of the east.

familiar.text: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

verses.restored: His sons would go and make a feast in the house of each one on his day, and they would send and call their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

familiar.text: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

verses.restored: When the days of feasting had gone around, Job would send and consecrate them. He would rise early in the morning and offer burnt offerings according to the number of them all, for Job said, Perhaps my children have sinned and blessed/cursed the Divine in their hearts. Thus Job did continually.

familiar.text: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

verses.restored: Now there was a day when the sons of the Divine came to present themselves before the Eternal, and the Accuser also came among them.

familiar.text: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.

verses.restored: The Eternal said to the Accuser, From where do you come? The Accuser answered the Eternal and said, From roaming through the earth and walking around in it.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.restored: The Eternal said to the Accuser, Have you set your heart on my servant Job? For there is none like him on the earth, a whole and upright man, fearing the Divine and turning away from evil.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

verses.restored: The Accuser answered the Eternal and said, Does Job fear the Divine for nothing?

familiar.text: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

verses.restored: Have you not placed a hedge around him, around his house, and around all that belongs to him on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his livestock has burst forth in the land.

familiar.text: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

verses.restored: But stretch out your hand now and touch all that belongs to him, and surely he will bless/curse you to your face.

familiar.text: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

verses.restored: The Eternal said to the Accuser, Look, all that belongs to him is in your hand; only against him do not stretch out your hand. So the Accuser went out from the presence of the Eternal.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.

verses.restored: There was a day when his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their firstborn brother.

familiar.text: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.restored: A messenger came to Job and said, The oxen were plowing and the female donkeys were feeding beside them,

familiar.text: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

verses.restored: and the Sabeans fell upon them and took them, and struck the servants with the edge of the sword. I alone escaped to tell you.

familiar.text: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.restored: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, Fire of the Divine fell from the heavens and burned up the sheep and the servants and consumed them. I alone escaped to tell you.

familiar.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.restored: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, Chaldeans formed three bands, raided the camels, took them, and struck the servants with the edge of the sword. I alone escaped to tell you.

familiar.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.restored: While this one was still speaking, another came and said, Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in the house of their firstborn brother,

familiar.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.restored: and look, a great wind came from across the wilderness and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young people, and they died. I alone escaped to tell you.

familiar.text: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

verses.restored: Job rose, tore his robe, shaved his head, fell to the ground, and bowed down.

familiar.text: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

verses.restored: He said, Naked I came out from my mother’s womb, and naked I shall return there. The Eternal gave, and the Eternal has taken. Let the name of the Eternal be blessed.

familiar.text: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

verses.restored: In all this, Job did not sin and did not give folly to the Divine.

familiar.text: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
